scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Solstice Lens installation on its confirmed mount-work slot while preserving the object's required handling conditions.
Emerging Need: The standard inbound schedule leaves insufficient sealed acclimatization time, while an earlier shared route could supply the missing prerequisite.
Decision Context: Installation certainty, lender release readiness, and carrier availability emerge through separate channels; the object-specific minimum is recorded only in the approved handling file, and the earlier route has a brief hold at the contracted rate.
Consequence: After that hold expires, the original installation slot cannot retain its intended handling margin, leaving delayed mount work or a director-approved schedule exception as the remaining outcomes.

parameter.body: For SL-47, our standard museum run delivers Wednesday, March 18 at 15:00. A shared early run can deliver Tuesday, March 17 at 08:00 at the same contracted rate. We are holding that space until Monday, March 16 at 12:00; after that the vehicle is assigned elsewhere.

parameter.content: The SL-47 crate is packed and can be released from our dock at 05:30 Tuesday, March 17. We have staff assigned for either the early shared vehicle or Wednesday's standard collection.

parameter.subject: Early route hold released for SL-47
parameter.body: The 12:00 hold on Tuesday's early run has expired and that vehicle has been allocated. SL-47 remains on Wednesday's standard run for 15:00 delivery.

parameter.name: solstice_lens_handling_requirements.txt
parameter.content: Approved handling requirement for object SL-47, Solstice Lens assembly: After delivery to the museum's conditioned receiving room, keep the shipping crate sealed for at least 72 continuous hours before any uncrating, mount fitting, or installation work begins.
